_comment: Two defenses. 'prompt_scan' is the static design check run by evaluate_kpi.py --scan on a system-prompt file: any match means a secret or internal detail sits in the prompt (REJECT). 'output' is the runtime output filter used in hardened mode: a reply line is withheld if it matches a pattern or shares an n-gram of 'ngram' words with the active system prompt. Patterns are regex, case-insensitive. Set 'ngram' to 0 to disable the overlap check.
